1. 골로새서 기록 배경\n 1) 에베소서와 함께 기록된 골로새서\n -:
1. Background of Colossians
 1) Colossians, written together with Ephesians
 - Colossians: Christ, the head of the church
에베소서는 그리스도의 몸 된 교회: Ephesians: the church, the body of Christ
골로새는 에베소 옆에 있죠?\n2) 골로새 지역\n - 바울이 개척한 교:
Colossae is right next to Ephesus, isn't it?
2) The region of Colossae
 - It wasn't a church Paul planted. It was founded by people from the school of Tyrannus who had learned the Scriptures from Paul. A man named Epaphras was pastoring it, and when he heard Paul had been imprisoned, he went all the way to Rome to find him. So Paul, with deep love and affection, wrote a Christology and sent it to them.
기독은 그리스도를 한자로 음역해서 기독이라고 하고 그래서 기독교라고 하는: In Korean, "Gidok" is the Chinese-character transliteration of "Christ," so Christianity is called "Gidokgyo." Strictly speaking, though, every religion that speaks of Christ is called Gidokgyo: Roman Catholic, Eastern Orthodox, Protestant, and so on. For us, it's more accurate to say "Gaesingyo," Protestant. "Gae" means to reform, "sin" means new.
2. 골로새서가 보여주는 그리스도\n 1) 선재하시는 그리스도\n - 모:
2. The Christ that Colossians shows
 1) The pre-existent Christ
 - He existed before any created thing existed.
 2) Christ the Creator
 - Creation wasn't done by God the Father alone; the triune God did it together.
 3) Christ, the image of God
 - We can't see God with our eyes, but if we could, He'd be just like Jesus
 4) Christ above the angels
 - He is above all angels, the visible world, the invisible world, all principalities, powers, and thrones
 5) Christ, filled with all the mysteries of God
 - All the mysteries of the universe are filled up in Christ.
 6) Christ the Savior
 - The phrase we're most familiar with
 7) Christ the Mediator
 - He is the one who mediates between us and God
 8) Christ, the Son of God
 9) Christ, the head of the church
 10) Christ dwelling in you
 11) Christ who will come again
 12) Christ who will judge the living and the dead
 -> It's packed full, through and through, with words about Christ.
3. 당시 골로새는 동서의 주요 교통 요충지로서 다양한 철학들이 공존 했:
3. Colossae at the time was a major crossroads between East and West, a place where all sorts of philosophies existed side by side. A heresy called the ‘Colossian heresy’ even showed up, a mishmash of Judaism and Gnosticism.
=> So Paul, in rebuttal to those ideas, bears witness to Christ who is preeminent in all things, and he goes on to describe His preeminence in four main relationships.
1. 하나님과 –1장 15절 하나님의 형상, 모든 피조물 보다 먼저 나: 1. With God – 1:15 the image of God, the firstborn before all creation.
2. With creation - 1:16,17 He is the Creator.
3. With the church - 1:18 He is the head of the church.
4. 구속사역 - 1장 19절~23절 십자가의 피로 하나님과 만물을 화목: 4. The work of redemption - 1:19~23 by the blood of the cross He reconciled all things to God and completed redemption
Verse 8: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit.
거짓교훈들의 특징 - 합리주의, 이성주의 => 계시를 부정함: Features of the false teachings - rationalism, reason-ism => they deny revelation
답변 9절 - 그리스도는 하나님의 충만으로 신자들이 그 안에서 충만하게: The answer, verse 9 - Christ is the fullness of God, and believers are being made full in Him.
The Godhead dwelt fully in Christ, who came in the flesh. He's a man, and He's God.
11절 손으로 하지 아니한 할례를 받았다. 12절에 있는 세례를 뜻하는: Verse 11: they received the circumcision made without hands. That means the baptism in verse 12.
세례를 통해 그리스도와 한 몸이 되어서 그가 죽을 때 우리도 죽고 주가: Through baptism we become one body with Christ, so when He died we died too, and when the Lord rose we rose too.
결론적 교훈은 16절 먹고 마시는 것, 절기, 안식일 같은 것으로 비판하: The concluding lesson is verse 16: don't let anyone judge you over eating and drinking, feasts, the Sabbath, things like that. Those are only a shadow of things to come. But Christ is the reality itself. So Christ is preeminent.
3장 4장은 실천편: Chapters 3 and 4 are the practical part
3장 그리스도와 함께 다시 살리심을 입었으면 위엣것을 찾으라고 권고함.\:
Chapter 3 urges: if you have been raised with Christ, seek those things which are above.
- Seeking the things above means putting to death your members which are on the earth; that's verse 5. Fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry. Putting these to death is the life that seeks the things above.
From verse 18 on, looks familiar, doesn't it? It's the same as what's in Ephesians.
6. 4장의 내용\n - 권면이 이어지는데 먼저 기도와 감사:
6. What's in chapter 4
 - The exhortations continue, first prayer and thanksgiving
That God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ....
바울의 편지들 보면 기도 부탁이 전부 전도, 복음 전하는 일 잘 하게 해: If you look at Paul's letters, his prayer requests are all about evangelism, asking that he'd do well at preaching the gospel.
이 편지는 회람문서 - 16절 돌려 읽으라고 권고: This letter was a circular - verse 16 urges them to pass it around and read it
17절 아킵보에게 주 안에서 받은 직분을 삼가 이루라고 하라. 아킵보는: Verse 17: say to Archippus, take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfil it. Archippus was Philemon's son.
아마도 어떤 이유에서인지 사역을 안 하고 있는 것 같은데 바울은 다시 일:
It seems that for some reason he wasn't doing his ministry, and Paul tells him to get up again and carry out the ministry he was given.
-> Colossians is saying: don't let your eyes wander to things like the empty philosophies of the world, let's get to know Christ properly.
